definition.name: Breathe
definition.description: Six slow breaths at an even pace: in for four, hold for four, out for four, hold for four, then it ends. Drawn rings, no sound. Not medical advice; stop if you feel dizzy.

credit.creator: Mantel
credit.attribution: Original ring drawing, made in code with AI assistance.

prompt.text: Sit comfortably. If you feel dizzy, stop and breathe normally. Breathe in slowly for four… then hold for four.
prompt.alt_text: Five wide rings, one inside another, filling the picture, with four dots around them.

reveal.text: Breathe out slowly for four… then hold for four.
reveal.alt_text: One small ring in the middle, with faint dotted rings around it and four dots.
